chunks: Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام was asked about a man who dies: may he be shrouded in three garments without a shirt?
He said: “There is no problem with that, and the shirt is more preferred to me.”

key_terms.قَمِيصٍ: a shirt used as part of the shroud
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal objection

ai.seo_question: Can a deceased person be shrouded in three garments without a shirt?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on shrouding the deceased. It states that shrouding in three garments without a shirt is permissible, while including a shirt is preferred.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.422 - Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) was asked about a man who dies and whether he can be shrouded in three garments without a shirt (Qamis).
Imam (as) said: "There is no problem with that, but having a shirt is more preferred to me."
